sources.excerpt: Himmelstrutz Elektro Art FETTO Nord+ Home News Amps Pedals Custom Shop Download About Contact Himmelstrutz Elektro Art FETTO Nord+: Feel the Authentic Sound Next Owner’s Manual Review… FETTO History NATURAL OVERDRIVE & BOOST FETTO Nord+ is an overdrive pedal designed for emphasising the best parts of your guitar and amplifier. It was developed in close cooperation with the Swedish musician and producer Mikael Nord Andersson . Traditional craftsmanship meets thoughtful design. It takes inspiration from the classic tones of cranked Marshall amps with a master volume, and the HIWATT DR103 with a non-colouring overdrive in front of it; this means it maintains a neutral character, enhancing your amplifier’s natural voice without overwhelming it. Hand-built with precision, the FETTO Nord+ is a reliable tool offering a natural extension of your sound. This completely analogue pedal is built using discrete valve-emulating components to preserve the integrity of your tone. It’s designed for clarity- and responsiveness-minded guitarists who want every note they play to come through with the quality and detail it had when it left their fingers – which Mikael has. The FETTO Nord+ doesn’t impose its own sound but works in conjunction with your setup to allow a more expressive and dynamic playing experience. More Note : If you want similar, great overdrive sounds – check out FETTO Custom or FETTO Jr . If this ain't good enough for you – as you need it straight seventies – check out FETTO Nord 70 or FETTO Jr. 70 ! IN / OUT Input Input impedance : approx. 1 MΩ Output Output impedance : approx. 10 kΩ Push Switches DRIVE / GIMME Mechanical true-bypass switching for the OVERDRIVE circuit (ON = Blue LED). BOOST / MORE Mechanical true-bypass switching for the BOOST circuit (ON = Orange LED). * DRIVE/BOOST order changeable via internal jumpers. Power DC Input 9–18 V DC , very low current draw. Optional AC adapter: 9–18 V DC, center-pin negative (BOSS-style, regulated). Potentiometers Drive Natural amp-like overdrive from light → medium → heavier textures (not Metal). Volume OVERDRIVE output level. Boost BOOST output level. Treble Passive high-frequency tone control. Internals * 1 × Drive Gain trimmer 1 × Drive Bass trimmer 1 × Boost Gain trimmer 3 × Jumpers for DRIVE/BOOST order * May vary slightly depending on production day, version and serial number. Dimensions & Weight Size 111.6 × 61.6 × 50.0 mm (L/W/H) Weight Approx. 310 g (0.7 lbs) Colour / Finish May vary depending on season and reason. From Feb 2010: Stockholm White (RAL 9010) with grey/silver print. The warranty does not include batteries and consumables. Product service is free of charge during the warranty time. The warranty does not include errors due to product modifications, internal adjustments, disassembly, negligence/violence, incorrect power supply usage/incorrect connections or thunder. Shipping costs in non warranty cases is on the product owner Hear FETTO Nord+ Handcrafted with Care and Expertise The FETTO Nord+ is handmade with care, ensuring that each unit is of the highest quality and can be relied upon. Each pedal is built to last, with an attention to detail using only the finest components that add to its reliability and consistent performance. In designing and shaping the FETTO Nord+, our collaboration with the so experienced Mikael Nord Andersson has been of utmost importance in combining practical experience with deep understanding of what guitarists need from their gear. Built to last, this pedal is intended for players who value both sound quality and durability. Himmelstrutz Elektro Art browse by type volume/amplification amplification preamp / clean boost browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive overdrive browse by enclosure pedal Himmelstrutz Fetto Nord+ - Great Wide Distortion + Boost Published on July 10, 2012 Himmelstrutz Elektro Art boost / preamp distortion overdrive pedal Information Himmelstrutz Elektro Art Fetto Nord+ is evil in a pleasant way and very tube-like. A paradox-a transparent tool with definite character and a lot of tonal possibilities. With any of the Fetto pedals it's easy to get crunchy or creamy distortion-at any volume. With the Nord's you also get an independent boost! Superb string separation, all the way from smooth overdrive into heavy distortion. You never lose the character of your instrument or amplifier and it's designed to match the volume control on your guitar perfectly. Most pedals sounds just like a pedal. Not the case with the Fettos which sound and feel like an extension of your amplifier-Tactilitus Maximus. Controls: Drive: Overdrive/Distortion control Tone: Tone control (passive treble cut) More: Boost level control Volume: as loud as you'll ever need Mid*: mid character (passive/3 way toggle) Presence*: more/less higher frequencies (passive/3 way toggle) GIMME: Overdrive true bypass switching MORE: Boost true bypass switching Internal controls: Bass, & Gain trimmers * Thanks to the Mid and Presence switches difficult amps (ala Fender) can also get Great distortion. Details: All original and handmade Himmelstrutz design. A further developed Fetto Nord cross-fertilized with the amazing Fetto Custom - Fetto Nord+ has identical toggle switch options as the Fetto Custom! Mechanical (true) bypass switching system: ON indicated with blue and orange LED's External Control knobs: 'Drive', 'Tone', 'Volume' and 'More' (pre or post distortion independent boost) External toggle switches: 'Mid', 'Presence' Internal controls: 'Bass' & 'Gain' trimmers + maybe something more (depending on the serial) Power Consumption: 9 V DC/3,5 mA (= rich battery life) AC Adapter (Optional): 5-18 V DC, center-pin negative (Straight plug, BOSS Standard connection, regulated power supply) Name, colour, finish: May vary depending on season and reason: May 2012- 'S
